summary: Sporting News' Week 15 NFL DFS column by Sloan Piva lists cheap sleepers and value plays at QB, RB, WR, TE and D/ST for DraftKings, FanDuel and SuperDraft. It recaps last week's hits, which averaged over 19 DK points per position player, and explains SuperDraft's multiplier scoring. Top picks include Brock Purdy, Jordan Love, Devin Singletary, Rashee Rice, Demarcus Robinson, David Njoku and the Rams D/ST.
one_line: Sporting News' Week 15 2023 NFL DFS column picks cheap sleepers and values at every position for DraftKings, FanDuel and SuperDraft lineups.
key_facts: Last week's Week 14 sleeper hits averaged over 19 DK points per position player and 18.4 per position while costing just under $5,200 per pick.
Week 14 hits included Garrett Wilson (23.1 pts at $5,500), Joe Mixon (21.5 at $6,100) and Baker Mayfield (20.1 at $5,300).
SuperDraft scoring uses point multipliers instead of salary caps; cheaper players on DK/FD carry higher boosts, and users can roster any player without restrictions.

Brock Purdy (49ers at Cardinals, DK $6,800) has 57.9 DK points over San Francisco's past two games and at least 23.8 in five of the past six; the Cardinals rank among the 10 most generous defenses to QBs.
Jordan Love (Packers vs. Buccaneers, DK $6,200) faces a Tampa Bay defense that has allowed the fourth-most FD points and fifth-most DK points to QBs.

Devin Singletary (Texans at Titans, DK $5,400) had 13 carries for 65 yards and a TD against the Jets, while Dameon Pierce had five touches for seven yards; C.J. Stroud is in concussion protocol and Nico Collins (calf) and Tank Dell (fibula) are injured.
Rashee Rice (Chiefs at Patriots, DK $6,100) has 57.3 PPR points over the past three weeks, with Isiah Pacheco (shoulder) banged up.

Demarcus Robinson (Rams vs. Commanders, DK $3,600) has a 21.8-percent target share over two weeks, with seven catches for 101 yards and two TDs; Washington has allowed the most FanDuel points and second-most DK points to WRs.
Romeo Doubs (DK $5,300) has logged 11-plus DK points eight times and at least 18.3 three times.
David Njoku (Browns vs. Bears, DK $4,700) caught six of eight targets from Joe Flacco for 91 yards and two TDs last week; the Bears have allowed the 10th-most PPR points to TEs.
Antonio Gibson (Commanders at Rams, DK $5,200) is a PPR value because Sam Howell has been sacked 10 more times than any other QB.
Rams D/ST (vs. Commanders, DK $3,100 | FD $4,300) has 17 sacks and six takeaways over its past six games; Howell leads the league in interceptions.
